criteria_evidence.criterion: P32 real terminal output: Chinese/ASCII names and coloured/plain output aligned by terminal display width, not by character count
criteria_evidence.evidence: Device-measured on two real consoles. Names: 主会话 = 6 cells for 3 characters, 检索定价核查表 = 14 cells for 7, 孙子代理乙 = 10 cells for 5 — the device's own cells, 2 per character (character counting would have said 3/7/5). Every field's device column equals the frontend's stated column on every row at every width (48 of 48 fields per pass). Colour: the lines carrying the theme's escape sequences are drawn by the device with 2/3/5/6/7 foregrounds (account line: four segment colours) while every other line keeps the device's single default attribute 7, and the coloured frame's columns and widths are identical to the plain frame's — a theme adds colours, no column. NOTE: the detail tree's own rows carry no theme colour at all in this implementation (only the monetary account line does), so the colour half is measured there; the tree's colour-freeness is reported as an observation, not as a claim.
